title: Pure Infernity
summary: Pure Infernity handless combo and negation build, playing the 2026 Archfiend's Usurpation engine without the Fiendsmith package alongside staples. The archetype operates exclusively while your hand contains zero cards, transforming empty-hand conditions into infinite resurrection loops between Infernity Archfiend and Necromancer to set up omni-negates like Infernity Barrier.

summary.title: Starters & Hand Emptying
points: Archfiend's Usurpation Sets Archfiend's Roar directly from your Deck and makes it activatable the same turn, allowing an instant revive of Infernity Archfiend to begin searching while empty-handed.
Infernity Sage (Level 2 Tuner) discards your entire hand upon Normal Summon to instantly achieve empty-hand status, and mills an Infernity monster when sent to the GY.
Infernity Wildcat Special Summons itself from hand by discarding another Infernity monster, modulating its Level for Synchro Summons.
Infernity Archfiend searches any Infernity card (Launcher, Barrier, or Break) whenever it is Special Summoned while you have no cards in your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Archfiend's Usurpation + Hand Dump
steps: Set all Spells and Traps in your hand to empty your hand, or discard them with Infernity Sage or Wildcat.
Activate Archfiend's Usurpation to Set Archfiend's Roar from your Deck, making it activatable this turn.
Activate Archfiend's Roar (paying 500 LP) to Special Summon Infernity Archfiend from your GY.
Infernity Archfiend triggers with an empty hand to search Infernity Launcher from your Deck.
Activate Infernity Launcher to send Infernity Necromancer and Infernity Mirage from hand or field, then send Launcher to GY to revive both.
Necromancer and Mirage continue looping Infernity Archfiend, searching Infernity Barrier and Infernity Suppression.

summary.title: The Infernity Loop
points: Infernity Necromancer switches to Defense Position to revive any Infernity monster from your GY once per turn while your hand is empty.
Infernity Mirage tributes itself while you control no cards in hand to Special Summon 2 Infernity monsters from your GY.
Infernity Launcher sends itself to the GY while empty-handed to Special Summon up to 2 Infernity monsters from your GY.
This Creepy Little Punk counts as an Infernity monster, revives an Infernity from anywhere, and provides additional loop redundancy.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Infernity Barrier is a Counter Trap that negates the activation of an opponent's Spell, Trap, or monster effect and destroys it while you control an Attack Position Infernity monster and have no cards in hand.
Infernity Suppression can be activated the turn it was Set while empty-handed, negating an opponent monster's activated effects for the turn.
Infernity Doom Archfiend (Level 6 Synchro) targets and negates a face-up card on the field and destroys it while empty-handed, dealing double battle damage.
Infernity Doom Dragon (Level 8 Synchro) destroys an opponent's monster and inflicts damage equal to half its ATK while you have no cards in hand.

allow.Archfiend's Usurpation: The page's 2026 starter: Sets Archfiend's Roar from the Deck, live that turn.
